create_fourier_embedding_grid: create a Fourier position embedding for a grid of coordinates with configurable axes and update type
create_sample_fourier_embedding: create a Fourier position embedding for sampled coordinates in [-1, 1] with optional explicit coords
convert_to_fourier_features: convert input coordinates to NeRF-style sinusoidal Fourier features for positional encoding
create_gradient_grid: create a tensor with equidistant coordinate entries across specified dimensions and value range
build_video_position_embeddings: build Fourier-based position embeddings for video models using grid or sampled coordinates
